title: Dedupe Stripe refund webhooks (fix double refunds, INC-2291)
summary: Fixes Stripe webhook double-refund issue (INC-2291) by adding processed_events table and dedupe lookup before applying refunds.
Author claims transaction atomicity and rollback path; CI and tests all green.
Critical bug found in implementation: records refund ID instead of event ID, defeating dedupe logic entirely.

why: Rule 1 (G1 FAIL): CONFIRMED CODE_DEFECT BLOCKER at src/webhooks/refundHandler.ts:26 — wrong field inserted into processed_events, allowing duplicate event processing and double-refunds.
The bug defeats the PR's entire purpose: dedupe lookup checks event.id but insertion records refund.id, so redelivered events are never detected.

issues.summary: Dedupe logic inserts wrong event identifier, defeating duplicate detection entirely.
issues.evidence: src/webhooks/refundHandler.ts:18 checks `db.processedEvents.findOne({ eventId: event.id })` (correct: Stripe event ID 'evt_1'), but line 26 inserts `{ eventId: refund.id }` (wrong: refund ID 're_1'). Redelivered events with same event.id will not be found because the inserted eventId is different. CONFIRMED by code inspection.
issues.scenario: Event evt_1 arrives twice from Stripe: (1) first call checks event.id='evt_1' (not in table), inserts refund.id='re_1', applies refund; (2) second call checks event.id='evt_1' (not found—we stored 're_1'), applies refund again. Customer balance credited twice, defeating the PR's core purpose.
issues.fix: Change line 26 from `await tx.processedEvents.insert({ eventId: refund.id, ...})` to `await tx.processedEvents.insert({ eventId: event.id, ...})`
issues.confirm_or_refute: Author can confirm with code inspection or provide a test that simulates Stripe redelivery: call handleRefundEvent(evt) twice with the same evt object and verify balance is only incremented once.
issues.next_action: Author: fix line 26 to use event.id. Re-run tests and push. Add or update test 'skips a true duplicate event' to call handleRefundEvent(evt) twice with same event object (without manual DB seeding) and assert duplicate return + no double-apply.

issues.summary: Test for dedupe does not simulate real Stripe redelivery scenario.
issues.evidence: Test 'skips an event that was already processed' manually inserts the eventId into the database before calling handleRefundEvent, rather than calling the function twice with the same event. comment_draft:
Great documentation and clear problem statement. Found a critical bug in the dedupe logic:

Line 26 of refundHandler.ts inserts `refund.id` but line 18 checks `event.id`. This defeats the entire deduplication: redelivered Stripe events will never be recognized as duplicates because the eventId stored doesn't match the eventId being looked up.

- [ ] Change line 26 to `eventId: event.id` (not `refund.id`)
- [ ] Add a test that calls handleRefundEvent(evt) twice with the same event object (without manual DB seeding) and asserts 'duplicate' return and single balance increment
- [ ] Confirm all tests and CI pass
- [ ] Request re-review

Once fixed, this is a solid PR. The architecture and test coverage are good; this is a simple typo-class bug.
